programme.title: Secrets of the Royal Palaces

Kate Williams also tells the tale of Elizabeth I's make-up, which was so poisonous that it would be illegal today, with her foundation made of lead and vinegar, her rouge from lead carbonate, and her lipstick from ground alabaster, with side-effects including digestive problems and respiratory issues

programme.title: Dogs Behaving (Very) Badly
programme.desc: Graeme Hall heads to Leeds to mediate in an all-out turf war between St Bernards Brodie and Rosie and little cockapoo Jasper. The relentless threat of conflict is stressing everyone out and the whole family is on constant high alert to keep the dogs from clashing. So much so they've been forced to live separate lives. The pressures on Graeme to broker a peace deal. Next, it's a trip down memory lane for Graeme as he revisits Labradoodle Doddle. Last time their paths crossed he was being a real headache for mum Sarah. He just wouldn't leave her son George alone - slobbering all over him at every opportunity. Graeme taught Doodle he could share the love but there needed to be boundaries. Now, there's something else creating a real hurdle for the family to get over

programme.title: Angela Rippon's River Cruises
programme.desc: Angela heads to Cambodia to travel along the Mekong, beginning by heading to see the majestic sunrise over the famous temple at Angkor Wat before boarding her cruise ship in Kampong Cham. Among her destinations are Angkor Ban, now a tourist hotspot, but known as the lucky village as it survived the atrocities in the 1970s of the Khmer Rogue, and the capital Phnom Penh, where sher heads to a temple complex to meet a man who is preserving ancient Cambodian manuscripts.

programme.title: Prince Harry in Therapy

programme.title: 1972: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Controversies, scandals and shocks in TV, film, music and politics, when a royal reunion proved divisive, Uri Geller demonstrated his fork-bending talents, and Cosmopolitan magazine was launched. A Clockwork Orange and Last Tango in Paris shocked cinema audiences, while did Jesus Christ Superstar did the same on stage

programme.title: 1971: The Year We Went Decimal
programme.desc: The decimalisation of British currency in 1971, when the ancient system of pounds, shillings and pence was replaced with decimal currency. Years in the making, the operation involved minting billions of coins, converting millions of machines and teaching the entire nation how to cope with this colossal conversion. It sparked the largest public information campaign the country had ever seen, complete with TV dramas, scantily clad women dubbed 'Decimal Dollies' and a song by Max Bygraves

programme.title: Walking Wartime Britain

programme.title: Digging Up Britain's Past

Plus, a look at how the garden's Tudor owner, Robert Dudley transformed his estate to win favour with his Queen

programme.title: Cruising with Jane McDonald
programme.desc: Part one of two. Jane sails around South America in style aboard an ultra-luxury ship. Starting in Valparaíso, she embraces her inner Banksy on a street art tour, before beginning her journey south along the Chilean coast. A few days later she reaches the breathtaking glacier on Laguna San Rafael. Here, Jane partakes in the customary and traditional drinking of whisky on ice directly from the glacier. She then ventures further south into deepest Patagonia, stopping off in Punta Arenas. Back on board the ship, Jane enjoys a tour of the bridge with the captain as they make their way to the Falklands

programme.title: Cruising with Jane McDonald
programme.desc: Part two of two. The singer concludes her trip to South America by stopping off in Argentina, where she visits the largest Welsh settlement outside of Wales before finding out about the life of former first lady Eva Peron in Buenos Aires. She then sails to Uruguay's capital Montevideo, where she seeks shelter from the rain in one of the country's oldest wineries

programme.title: Pompeii: Life in the City
programme.sub-title: Pompeii: Life in the City with Dan Snow
programme.desc: Dan Snow and Kate Lister discover what Romans got up to in their spare time. At Pompeii's open-air gym, Dan is put through an authentic Roman workout. Kate takes a trip to the public baths, where everyone, man and woman, rich and poor, could get clean and gather for a chat. The pair are also shown how to dress as Romans would have done

programme.title: Pompeii: Life in the City
programme.sub-title: Pompeii: Life in the City with Dan Snow
programme.desc: Dan and Kate Lister discover that in Pompeii, crime and violence were a daily threat. Dan tracks down evidence of the extreme measures taken to protect Pompeii's posh houses, including huge front doors with elaborate locks, guard dogs and bouncers. Kate explores how Pompeii earned a reputation as a place where a day of entertainment could end in mass murder

programme.title: James May's Great Explorers
programme.desc: James follows Walter Raleigh's rise from rural Devon to London high-society. He meets top barrister Benet Brandreth KC at The Honourable Society of the Middle Temple to learn the techniques of persuasion that allowed Raleigh to talk his way to the top. James also explores the darker and more complex corners of Raleigh's legacy

programme.title: The High Street Shops We Loved & Lost
programme.desc: Part one of two. A look back at the high street of yesteryear, celebrating favourite shop brands, including Wimpy, Top Shop, Tammy Girl, Blockbuster and BHS. Plus, a tribute to one of the most missed shop brands of them all, Woolworths, and in particular its much-loved sweets section. Nick Hewer traces the chain's rise to becoming a cherished high street fixture, while former Woolies shop assistant Cheryl Baker reveals secrets from the other side of the counter. Narrated by Hayley Tamaddon

programme.title: 5 News Weekend

programme.title: The High Street Shops We Loved & Lost
programme.desc: Part two of two. A look back at an era when booking a holiday meant a trip to the high street to visit Lunn Poly or Thomas Cook. There's also a celebration of the new giants that revolutionised shopping habits, from Our Price and Toys R Us in the 80s to Athena and Phones 4U in the 90s. Anne Hegerty and Lesley Joseph bemoan the loss of Debenhams, Robert Elms spills the beans on his time as a less-than-helpful shop assistant, and Mark Heyes sees reasons for optimism that the high street as we knew and loved it could still have a future

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: Three young men who love to party ditch their hedonistic lifestyles to spend a week with Carmelite friars in a secluded Oxfordshire priory, where they are thrust into a strict routine of silence, prayer and manual work. Struggling with early starts, no phones and long periods of reflection, tensions rise as Max, Luke and Alan question the faith and discipline, but through charity work with the homeless, moments of honesty and unexpected camaraderie with the brothers, cracks begin to show in their bravado. As the week unfolds, each confronts personal challenges and gains fresh perspective on responsibility, connection, and what really gives life meaning

programme.desc: Factual drama, starring Laura Bayston, depicting the interrogation of Kate McCann about her daughter's disappearance from the family's holiday apartment in Portugal, 2007. programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Meri Haan Teri Naa
programme.desc: Childhood friends Ashok and Julie are very close and believe friendship is above love. However, when Julie's father dies, Ashok and his wife bring her to their house and try to find a groom for her.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Ek Taqatwar The Mighty
programme.desc: Raju, a thug, falls in love with a girl and gives up his corrupt practices. However, he gets framed for a major scam that brings out his dark past, sabotaging his relationship.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Pithamagan
programme.desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help Karol and Richard with their tired and impractical three-bedroom bungalow in St Osyth, Essex. programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Airing from 2005 to 2009 on NBC, the game show series returns to primetime TV with original host Howie Mandel. A contestant must choose from 26 sealed briefcases containing a marker for various amounts of cash -- from one penny to $1 million. The player then eliminates the remaining 25 cases one by one. The chosen ones are opened and the amount of money inside revealed. After several cases are opened, the player is tempted by the Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for not continuing the game and possibly winning a larger sum of money.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: While scavenging items from a derelict space station, a group of young colonisers fight for survival when they cross paths with lethal life forms. Co-writer/director Fede Alvarez's horror sequel set between the events of Alien and Aliens, starring Cailee Spaeny, David Jonsson and Isabela Merced.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot attempts to solve a murder while on a luxury cruise down the famous Egyptian river. Mystery, based on the Agatha Christie novel, directed by and starring Kenneth Branagh, with Gal Gadot, Annette Bening and Armie Hammer.

programme.title: Celebs Go Dating

programme.title: Married at First Sight USA
programme.desc: With the couples' Panama honeymoons drawing to a close, it's time for them to face up to the reality of everyday life with their new spouses. Some of them are excited to start planning for the future, while others are already craving more personal space. And one bride's attempt at intimacy takes an unexpected - and extremely awkward - turn

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: A day at the roller-skating rink leaves Murray wishing he had not asked Erica to tell him about her life, while Pops steps in to help when a back-to-school shopping trip causes problems between Beverly and Adam. Comedy, starring Jeff Garlin, Wendi McLendon-Covey and Hayley Orrantia

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry needs the money to buy an expensive new pair of basketball trainers, so Murray hires him to work at his furniture shop. Beverly refuses to let Adam see a new horror film, but he goes behind her back and tricks Pops into taking him to the cinema. Comedy, starring Wendi McLendon-Covey and Jeff Garlin

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: When Jake's favourite pizzeria burns down, the fire marshal (Patton Oswalt) believes the owner should be the prime suspect in the investigation. Outraged, the detective does everything in his power to prove him wrong, even if it means stepping outside his jurisdiction. Meanwhile, chaos ensues at the precinct after a computer virus publishes everyone's internet browser history

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Christmas in the Snow
programme.desc: Laid-back Liam plans to wow his bride with a wintry white wedding. But almost 2,000 miles away in Portugal, bride-to-be Georgia is dreaming of sun, sand and sangria. Will Liam get everyone in the Christmas spirit, or will Georgia lose that loving feeling?

programme.title: Lego Masters Australia
programme.desc: In the third elimination challenge of the series, the six teams have 10 hours to build an instantly recognisable scene from a classic TV show of their choice inside a pre-made hollow vintage TV. Guest judge Sophie Monk attempts to identify the shows, with three bonus points up for grabs if she doesn't need any clues

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: Comedy clips showcasing amusing internet videos featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorcycle and bicycle variety

programme.title: The Amazing Race Australia
programme.desc: On Borneo, the final four teams get hands-on gutting fish at a bustling market and dive headfirst into a conservation mission. However, saving the planet takes a toll on the would-be eco warriors

programme.title: Married at First Sight USA
programme.sub-title: I Do, Deep in the Heart of Austin
programme.desc: Ten singles from Austin, Texas are ready to marry complete strangers in the ultimate quest for love. The first two couples say I do, sparks fly for one pair, but first impressions falter when one newly-wed clashes with their in-laws and another faces a shocking twist with their new family

programme.title: Married at First Sight USA
programme.sub-title: Don't Mess with My Texas Wedding
programme.desc: Four more singles prepare to meet their matches at the altar, but it's not the first time some of them have said 'I do'. The two couples who've already tied the knot spend their first night together

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: First of a two-part special in which Gordon Ramsay heads to the Burger Kitchen in Los Angeles, where tensions are running high because owner Alan Saffron has spent his son's entire inheritance on the struggling restaurant. To make matters worse, the kitchen is run by a chef called David Blaine who shares nothing of his famous namesake's magic when it comes to cooking - and whose threatening behaviour regularly gets him into trouble

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Part two of two. The chef continues his quest to transform the fortunes of the Burger Kitchen in Los Angeles, where tensions were running high because owner Alan Saffron had spent his son's entire inheritance on the struggling restaurant. Alan gets a wake-up call from internet critics, who he believes are trying to shut him down

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay visits family-run Luigi's in Orange County, California, where lazy shortcuts following the retirement of the owner's father have led the business to suffer. Ramsay faces the daunting task of reuniting a feuding family, before turning around the struggling restaurant, which currently has 126 dishes on the menu

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to the Park's Edge restaurant in Atlanta, Georgia, where a series of spats with the local community are hampering its success. Owners Richard and Jorge's in-fighting has alienated locals, and the duo's suggestion that customer numbers are low because of racism has heightened tensions

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family goes away to Marge's favourite childhood holiday destination, which has unfortunately changed since she was last there. Homer spurs the locals into sprucing the place up, but an exuberant firework display wrecks everything, forcing him to make amends by becoming a fisherman

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.sub-title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Three Times
programme.desc: Three stories of vengeance, featuring Homer being accused of treason in post-revolutionary France, Milhouse leading a rebellion of misfits in modern-day Springfield and a new crimefighter by the name of Red Revenge takes to the streets of Springfield

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart is awarded a driving licence for saving Springfield from a fire, and finds himself tied down when he develops a serious relationship with a teenage girl in a nearby town. Meanwhile, Lisa lands herself in trouble by falsely claiming Native American heritage. With the voice of Natalie Portman

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa accepts an invitation to join a Wiccan coven - but before she can be initiated, Chief Wiggum arrives and arrests the other members on charges of witchcraft. Meanwhile, Homer befriends local hillbilly Cletus, eager to share his plentiful supply of illegal moonshine liquor

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart decides he wants a little brother, and unofficially adopts a youngster named Charlie from the local orphanage - much to the dismay of Lisa. With the guest voices of Kim Cattrall (Sex and the City) and American Football stars Peyton and Eli Manning

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: During a trip to a water park with the family, Grampa bumps into a newspaper columnist who seemingly becomes fascinated with his life and writes a series of stories about him, but Homer becomes suspicious of the journalist's motives

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Time in Springfield
programme.desc: Ratings for Krusty's TV show start to fall, so executives bring in co-star Princess Penelope (voiced by Anne Hathaway) to increase its appeal, and romance soon blossoms between the clown and his new sidekick. Elsewhere, Mr Burns cuts costs at the nuclear plant by taking away the staff's free doughnuts

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer wins $1million on the lottery, but keeps it a secret from his family, fearing Marge's reaction if she finds out about it. He and Bart set about spending the money, and buy front-row tickets to a Coldplay concert. With the guest voice of Chris Martin

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: The inventor of an advanced form of intelligent robot is found dead, and the detective investigating the case is certain that one of the scientist's mechanical creations is responsible - but no one believes his theory because the robots have been programmed to prevent them from harming humans. programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: A debt-ridden paroled thief decides to pull off one last burglary before finally going straight. Adding to his stress level is his girlfriend - who knows nothing of his nefarious past. Crime drama, starring Richard Crenna, Angie Dickinson, Cameron Mitchell and Hurd Hatfield

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: A young woman's chaotic life becomes more complicated when she inherits her grandmother's dog. Comedy, starring Beattie Edmondson, Ed Skrein, Jennifer Saunders and Cherie Lunghi

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: Teenager Charlie discovers his frequently absent father is secretly a superhero after finding the hi-tech headquarters under his home. However, when an evil mastermind hatches a plot, it falls to Charlie and his friends to use the lair's resources to save the day. Comedy adventure, starring Owen Wilson and Michael Pena

programme.title: The Black Swan
programme.desc: Notorious pirate Henry Morgan is made governor of Jamaica, and offers other buccaneers the choice of giving up their lawless ways or facing justice. Two rogues refuse to toe the line, so Morgan's trusted ally James Waring is sent to track them down, but has other things on his mind - namely winning the daughter of the previous governor away from her duplicitous fiance. High-seas adventure, with Tyrone Power, Laird Cregar, George Sanders, Maureen O'Hara and Anthony Quinn

programme.title: Romancing the Stone
programme.desc: A romantic novelist goes in search of her kidnapped sister in the steamy jungles of South America, only to become the target of a villainous general who demands as a ransom the valuable treasure map in her possession. Help is at hand in the form of a craggy daredevil fortune hunter, who has his eye on a share of the profits. Comedy adventure, starring Michael Douglas, Kathleen Turner and Danny DeVito

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: A music executive heads out to a Cornish fishing village on a mission to recruit a group of 10 local fishermen into recording an album of sea shanties. He struggles to win over the unlikely boy band and their families, but begins to gain a new appreciation for their traditional values. Comedy, starring James Purefoy, Daniel Mays and Tuppence Middleton

programme.title: The Woman King
programme.desc: King Ghezo succeeds his brother on the throne of the West African kingdom of Dahomey, in direct opposition to the Oyo Empire. To repel enemy troops under the command of General Oba Ade, Ghezo entrusts the kingdom's fate to General Nanisca and an all-female group of warriors called the Agojie. Historical drama, starring Viola Davis, Thuso Mbedu and Lashana Lynch

programme.title: Sleep
programme.desc: A pregnant wife must figure out how to stop her husband's nightmarish sleepwalking habits before he harms himself. Korean comedy horror, starring Jung Yu-mi and Lee Sun-kyun

programme.title: Baby Ruby
programme.desc: A successful lifestyle entrepreneur is happily pregnant, awaiting the arrival of her first child. But soon after the birth, something starts to feel off, while seemingly perfect neighbourhood mothers become desperate to befriend her. She is plunged into a waking fever dream where everyone is a threat and nothing is as it seems. Psychological horror, starring Noémie Merlant and Kit Harington

programme.title: Tad The Lost Explorer and the Curse of the Mummy
programme.desc: Chicago-bricklayer-turned-adventurer Tad is digging in Mexico when he finds an Egyptian sarcophagus hidden underground behind many booby traps. Tad falls into an abyss and has to be rescued by his more competent colleague - and sweetheart - Sara. Animated adventure, with the voice of Oscar Barberan

programme.title: Monkey Business
programme.desc: Mayhem is unleashed when a mischievous chimpanzee pours a potent youth serum into the water system, causing the hapless chemist who developed it to regress to childhood, along with his wife, boss and secretary. Comedy, starring Cary Grant, Ginger Rogers, Charles Coburn and Marilyn Monroe

programme.title: The 300 Spartans
programme.desc: The ruler of the Persian empire vows to expand his realm by conquering Greece. The king of Sparta steps forward to defend his homeland and the other kingdoms of Greece, but when he is betrayed by a political council, he finds himself without an army and must fend off the vast invading army with a mere 300 warriors. Historical drama, starring Richard Egan, Ralph Richardson and Diane Baker

programme.title: Jerry and Marge Go Large
programme.desc: A couple discover a mathematical loophole in the Massachusetts lottery and win millions to revive and rejuvenate their small town. Comedy drama based on a true story, starring Bryan Cranston, Annette Bening, Rainn Wilson and Larry Wilmore

programme.title: Entrapment
programme.desc: An elusive professional art thief suspected of stealing a priceless painting is pursued by an insurance agent. However, instead of bringing the criminal to book, she teams up with him to plot the robbery of a lifetime - although neither is sure the other can be trusted. Crime thriller, starring Sean Connery, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Ving Rhames, Will Patton and Maury Chaykin

programme.title: Angel Has Fallen
programme.desc: Secret Service agent Mike Banning is framed for an assassination attempt on the President. Pursued by his own agency and the FBI, Banning races to clear his name and uncover the real terrorist threat - which has set its sights on Air Force One. Action thriller sequel, starring Gerard Butler and Morgan Freeman

programme.title: 3:10 to Yuma
programme.desc: A rancher seizes the chance to settle his debts and earn his son's respect by agreeing to escort a notorious outlaw to the town of Contention, where a train will take the prisoner to jail. But the journey takes a dangerous turn when the criminal tries to manipulate the rancher into letting him go - while his henchmen lie in wait. Western remake, starring Russell Crowe, Christian Bale and Gretchen Mol

programme.title: Corpus Christi
programme.desc: When a 20-year-old criminal experiences a spiritual transformation after his release from prison, he decides to minister a small-town parish, which also offers an opportunity for the local community to begin the healing process after a tragedy that happened there. Drama, starring Bartosz Bielenia, Aleksandra Konieczna and Eliza Rycembel. In Polish

programme.title: The Mouse That Roared
programme.desc: Classic farce in which the tiny Grand Duchy of Fenwick declares war on the United States with the aim of glorious defeat and a hefty sum in post-war aid. An advance party travels to New York and kidnaps the inventor of the Q-bomb, unfortunately forcing the Americans into immediate surrender.

programme.title: Written on the Wind
programme.desc: Emotional upheavals abound for a rich Texas oil family when their son and his childhood friend fall for the same woman.

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero
programme.desc: Preston Sturges' satire about a sickly soldier discharged from duty and mistaken for a war hero when he returns home.

programme.title: The Story of Robin Hood and His Merrie Men
programme.desc: Robin Hood, the dashing rogue, embarks on a legendary campaign against the evil Prince John and the Sheriff of Nottingham.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now
programme.desc: In Vietnam in 1970, Captain Willard takes a perilous and increasingly hallucinatory journey upriver to find and terminate Colonel Kurtz, a once-promising officer who has reportedly gone completely mad. In the company of a Navy patrol boat filled with street-smart kids, a surfing-obsessed Air Cavalry officer, and a crazed freelance photographer, Willard travels further and further into the heart of darkness.

A dinner party classic is made over, and Ina's chocolate pecan scones are a sweet indulgence worthy of any party.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S17 E4 — Thanksgiving New IdeasIna Garten shares a collection of restaurant-inspired dishes to cook at home. Ina cooks with Grand Pellegrino for the famous Rao's restaurant and finds out the best kitchens in America.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S26 E10 — Cook Like a Pro: SpicySome like it hot, and some like it spicy, so Ina Garten is making dishes to please both. She starts with an exotic lamb and chickpea curry made with a fragrant mix of spices, and her lobster corn fritters are paired with creamy sriracha sauce.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S26 E14 — Cook Like a Pro: Make-Ahead EntertainingIna Garten starts with two easy appetisers: mustard and Gruyère batons, and warm dates with blue cheese and prosciutto. Her main course is Moroccan lamb tagine with steamed couscous, and she whips up a decadent chocolate cake for dessert.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S26 E15 — Like A Pro: Holiday BrunchIna assembles a gorgeous seasonal brunch. On the menu are morning glory muffins, a fresh fruit platter, shakshuka with feta, and a spicy Bloody Mary.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S26 E16 — Cook Like a Pro: PorkIna Garten shares inventive ways to cook with pork. On the menu are sausage strudels, butternut squash and herbed pork tenderloins.

programme.title: Jamie's Money Saving Meals

programme.title: Jamie's Money Saving Meals

programme.desc: S1 E10 — CakesThis episode is all about cakes with plenty of twists on traditional recipes, including chocolate cola cake, boiled orange and Brazil nut cake, honey and hazelnut cake, and Granny's dripping cake.

programme.title: Roux Down the River

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E6 — MobileAdam Richman's eating adventure has brought him to beautiful Mobile, Alabama. First, Adam heads over to the Hungry Owl to try a burger that Mobile natives say is the 'best in 'Bama'.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E7 — Florida KeysAdam Richman's tasty travels have brought him to the Florida Keys, an archipelago at the southernmost tip of the continental United States. The Florida Keys is the fishing capital of the world.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E11 — MilwaukeeA sampling of Wisconsin's finest meats and an eating challenge in under 23 minutes with a huge burger, fries and six blazing-hot wings.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E23 — SavannahThe nationwide quest for tasty eats has led Adam Richman to the historic city of Savannah, Georgia. First, Adam heads to Sweet Potatoes for a taste of peach glazed BBQ chicken, a southern classic.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E9 — PortsmouthAdam's cross-country culinary quest brings him to Portsmouth, New Hampshire. Adam's first stop is Gilley's, which has been serving up delicious burgers for nearly a century.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E8 — Gulf CoastAdam's culinary crusade takes him on a road trip along the beautiful Gulf Coast in search of delicious eats. Adam begins his journey at The Shed in Ocean Springs, Mississippi.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E10 — LouisvilleAdam's all-American eats lands him in Louisville, Kentucky, home to bluegrass, bourbon and the Kentucky Derby. Adam starts off at the legendary Brown Hotel to try a taste of the original Hot Brown.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E13 — DallasAdam travels to Dallas to sample Texas-style bratwurst and BBQ brisket; a Texan seeks victory over five pounds of Vietnamese Pho in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E12 — ProvidenceAdam Richman's eating expedition has brought him to the capital city of the Ocean State - Providence, Rhode Island. Adam first heads over to Bob And Timmy's to try their unique grilled pizza.

programme.title: Man v. Food Nation
programme.desc: S4 E14 — Route 66Adam Richman's tasty travels take him on a road trip across the Main Street of America, Route 66. Adam's first stop is in St Louis, Missouri, to try some famous frozen custards.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E11 — GarlicJames prepares roasted garlic bread, salmon with garlic and champ and pan-fried dauphinoise potatoes. To see how garlic grows in the UK, James takes a trip to the Isle of Wight.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E12 — PorkJames applies his know-how to barbecued spare ribs, pork terrine and roast belly pork. He also visits Andover farmers' market to find the best local ingredients.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E14 — BreadJames prepares olive oil focaccia with rosemary, anchovy pizza and poppy seed snap. He visits De Gustibus bakery in London to get some tips from a master baker.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E15 — WatercressJames Martin prepares red onion and crème fraîche pizza, watercress and scallop salad and watercress and Stilton soup. The country around Winchester is famous for watercress, and James visits a grower and learns that the secret is in the water.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E1 — CakesTen passionate home bakers take part in a 'bake off', which will test every aspect of their baking skills as they battle it out to be crowned the Great British Bake Off's Best Amateur Baker. Each week the bakers are put through three challenges. The competition kicks off with cake in the Cotswolds. The bakers tackle three increasingly difficult challenges, starting off with their signature bake.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E2 — BiscuitsMel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins take the eight passionate home bakers who made it through the first round to Scone Palace near Perth to make biscuits and teatime treats.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E3 — BreadIt is week three of the competition and the six remaining bakers are making bread in Kent. In the shadow of Sarre Windmill, the bakers will be kneading, proving and knocking back their dough under the watchful eye of baking writer Mary Berry and master baker Paul Hollywood.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E4 — PuddingsIt's week four and the remaining five bakers have travelled to Bakewell in Derbyshire. This time the bakers are reinventing an often neglected British classic - the pudding.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E5 — PastryIt's the penultimate round and as the travelling marquee pitches up in the Cornish village of Mousehole, it's time for the bakers to get to grips with the most difficult of all baking skills - pastry. They bake their own versions of hearty British pies, get down to details with exquisite pastry canapés, and take a crash-course in crimping for this week's surprise bake.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Tea PartyIt's the Grand Final and the last three surviving contestants face their biggest challenge yet - baking for the Bake Off's Afternoon Tea Party. In order to be crowned the victor, they will need to bring together all of their skills, making cakes, bread and pastry.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Football
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Manchester UnitedAdam is in Manchester to watch the Red Devils play. He gets stuck into an epic seafood boil and a new sweet and savoury take on sourdough pizza.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Football
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Tottenham HotspurAdam dives into Tottenham's football food culture. He tries lamb ravioli in the stadium, and small plates at a restaurant serving West African tapas.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S1 E11 — PortlandIn Portland, Oregon, Adam takes on the 'Great Balls of Fire' challenge of five habanero chilli cheese fritters drenched in habanero hot sauce.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: S1 E12 — SeattleAdam Richman's journey brings him to Seattle, Washington, and Red Mill Burgers, which serves onion rings that are voted the best in the country. Then it's on to The Crab Pot for a huge plate of seafood.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Northern Irish CoastJames' British adventure has crossed over the Irish Sea to Northern Ireland, where he is joined by his great pal and famous local chef, Paul Rankin. Their first port of call is the Giant's Causeway, where James settles right in and cooks up a fish stew for the crowds of tourists. Paul goes in search of Irish gold and finds it in the form of rapeseed at the Kane family farm in Limavady.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — BelfastJames and Paul are having a blast in Northern Ireland, and they've reached Paul's home town of Belfast, where he's giving James a personal tour of Northern Ireland's capital city before they head off for a spot of golf. James pitches up his mobile kitchen right on the green to whip up a tasty dish with bacon, scallops and apples with onion rings. After all his exertion on the golf course, Paul heads just out of town to Carnbrooke Meats.

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: A man is stabbed at the entrance to a block of flats, but manages to call for help before collapsing. A young man has had 13 seizures in one day and needs urgent medical care. While treating a patient, the paramedics discover that he has allegedly assaulted someone else, and now have two patients on their hands. Plus, a taxi driver has a woman who is having a seizure in the back of his cab

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: A 78-year-old man has difficulty breathing after breaking several ribs by tripping over a kerb, and doctors discover that a woman is in the latter stages of pancreatic cancer when they treat her for sepsis. Elsewhere, a 32-year-old woman is treated after bruising her neck and face when she slipped on wet decking on a night out with friends

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Patients whose visions of the world are rocked by life-changing events, including 44-year-old Sergio, who is flown in by air ambulance after a cycling accident. Another cyclist - 71-year-old Alan - arrives in resus after being in a collision with a van. Doctors suspect a head injury and multiple fractures. Alan's wife Jenny reveals how she met him and how a sudden accident involving her son burst their idyll and took their lives on an unexpected path

programme.title: Food Unwrapped
programme.desc: Another selection of favourite investigations from the team. Jimmy Doherty hears about a threat to British juniper berries that could mark the end of gin's recent resurgence in popularity, while Kate Quilton delves into the contents of herbal bedtime teas to establish if they really can help people get to sleep more easily. Big oyster fan Matt Tebbutt wonders why he never finds pearls in his seafood platters so sets off for China, where he discovers that pearl production is full of surprises

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: This contest kicks off in north Norfolk at The Hero, run by best friends Harry Farrow and Rowan Glennie, who both quit university to follow their dream of becoming hospitality entrepreneurs. Debbie and Arthur from The Cleasewood Guest House are wowed by the view, but Shoukry and Waguih from Four Saints Brig y Don wonder if size really does matter. During an afternoon cheese-wrapping contest at a local dairy farm, Helen and Suzanne from Peel Hey show their perfectionist side, while Arthur and Debbie's sneaky tactics raise eyebrows

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The second visit is to the Cleasewood Guest House in Great Yarmouth, Norfolk, a labour of love for rookie B&B owners Debbie and Arthur Callaghan

programme.title: Four in a Bed

Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles

Steven Spielberg's blockbusting thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Richard Dreyfuss and Robert Shaw, with an Oscar-winning score by John Williams. The film also won Academy Awards for Best Sound and Best Film Editing

Thriller, starring Kim Basinger, Jason Statham, Chris Evans and William H Macy

programme.desc: The broadcaster explores the Galapagos, a collection of volcanic islands in the Pacific known for its extraordinary wildlife. programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos

programme.title: Bomber: Terror Of Wwii
programme.desc: E2When the Second World War broke out, bombers were one of the first weapons used in it. Bombings forced the use of gas masks and the construction of shelters, and children were evacuated from bombed-out cities.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E4After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Battle of the Coral Sea.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E7Facing a Soviet Army that grows stronger and pushes German forces back across the lands they occupied, and facing devastation of German cities by Allied bombers, Goebbels issues a call for “Total War”.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Icons of the Royal Navy in different eras, the Belfast and the Harrier have earned their place in history for different reasons.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4Two of the most produced combat machines in World War II managed to stay relevant until the end of the war through constant modernization and new variants.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E8The bloodiest months of the war are still ahead. A Soviet surge pushes German forces back to within 30 kilometres of the Polish Border. The siege at Leningrad is lifted after 900 days and Operation Overlord, D-Day, opens a second front in Europe.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E3Soviet troops suffered huge casualties in Rzhev in 1941, causing the bloody battle to be grimly nicknamed the Meat-Grinder. This is a look at events from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E4An attack on Soviet oil fields could have won the Germans the war, but massive resistance thwarted Hitler's dream.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E9The defeat at Stalingrad in 1943 was the turning point of the war and convinced the Nazi leadership to intensify their terror and propaganda campaigns.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E10In 1945, WWII was over but the violence had not ended. The survivors want to blame the Germans. The reckoning with National Socialism is ambivalent.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E4After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Battle of the Coral Sea.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E7Facing a Soviet Army that grows stronger and pushes German forces back across the lands they occupied, and facing devastation of German cities by Allied bombers, Goebbels issues a call for “Total War”.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E1Archive film, computer-generated imagery and innovative reconstructions tell the story of the Red Army's bloody 1941 defeat by Nazi Germany in Kiev.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E2The siege at Sevastopol forced the Germans to bring in some of the biggest artillery guns ever used. See Hitler's invasion from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E1Albert Speer was Hitler’s favorite architect and a central figure within the Führer’s inner circle. Speer’s buildings helped cement Hitler’s position and push Germany towards war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E2Wernher von Braun was instrumental to NASA’s Apollo 11 mission that put a man on the moon. His pioneering work in rocketry made it possible, but his past was kept under wraps.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E3Werner Heisenberg is one of the most controversial scientists of the Third Reich. A key figure in the Nazis’ efforts to build an atomic bomb, the target of an Allied assassination plot.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E4Hans Kammler’s fingerprints can be found all over the Third Reich’s most prestigious and deadly engineering projects—not as an architect or inventor, but as a project manager.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E5In Porsche, Hitler found a talented designer capable of leading Germany to new heights on the racetrack, while also helping rally the support of the masses at home.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E6Fritz Todt was Hitler’s leading engineer and his Minister of Armaments. He was the man the Führer tasked with the most demanding engineering projects.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E1Nazi Germany boasted that its locomotives were faster and more innovative. This programme examines that claim by looking at these ‘flying trains’.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E2Veterans and historians of the Thai-Burma railway tell the story of its construction. Built to supply Japan’s invasion of India, it cost thousands of lives – both POWs and Asian slave labourers.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E4In the 19th century, weapons became more sophisticated and more deadly, and the results were higher casualties with devastating wounds.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E7Historian Neil Faulkner tells the story of Lawrence of Arabia and his pioneering guerilla warfare against the railways of the Ottoman Empire.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E8This episode features tales of the heroism of the railway staff during the Blitz, and how a small siding in a Hampshire railway station played its part in the preparations for D-Day.
